{{Vanilla|Gunpowder}}
{{Infobox auto}}
A '''sulfur chunk''' is a yellow mineral used for explosives, fire and alchemy. It replaces {{MCW|Gunpowder|gunpowder}}: it is mined from sulfur ores as well as dropped by creepers, and it links to the [[Sulfur blocks|sulfur blocks]] of the sulfur caves, which can be broken back down into chunks.

== Obtaining ==
=== Mining ===
Sulfur chunks drop from the pack's sulfur ores: [[Sulfur Deposit|sulfur deposits]] and [[Sulfurous Hellstone|sulfurous hellstone]] (1–2 each), and [[Sulfurous Quartz Deposit|sulfurous quartz deposits]], which also drop [[quartz]].<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/minecraft/loot_table/blocks/deepslate_redstone_ore.json}}</ref> See [[Ores]].

=== Crafting ===
{{Recipes}}
* A block of [[Sulfur blocks|sulfur]] crafts into 1 sulfur chunk.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/crafting/sulfur_chunk_from_sulfur.json}}</ref>
* A block of potent sulfur crafts into 9.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/crafting/sulfur_chunk_from_potent_sulfur.json}}</ref>

=== Mob loot ===
Creepers and ghasts drop sulfur chunks as they drop gunpowder in vanilla. Sulfur cubes, which drop nothing in vanilla, drop 1–2 sulfur chunks and 1–2 [[Sulfur Goo|sulfur goo]] when killed by a player.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/minecraft/loot_table/entities/sulfur_cube.json}}</ref>

=== Other sources ===
{{Sources}}

== Usage ==
{{Uses}}
Sulfur chunks keep every use of gunpowder, and add several of their own:
* '''[[TNT]]''': four sulfur chunks with five paper or sand make 2 TNT.
* '''[[Benzene]]''': one sulfur chunk with a glass bottle and three [[hellspore]].
* '''[[Phosphor]]''': one sulfur chunk, a water bottle and four glow lichen make 8.
* '''Fire charges''': a sulfur chunk, [[Estus Ash|estus ash]] and coal or charcoal make 4.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/crafting/fire_charge.json}}</ref>
* '''Green dye''': a sulfur chunk, raw copper and a water bottle make 2.
* '''Sulfur blocks''': four chunks make 4 blocks of sulfur, and nine chunks (or blocks of sulfur) make a block of potent sulfur.

Picking up a sulfur chunk unlocks the TNT, fire charge, green dye, sulfur and potent sulfur recipes; benzene and phosphor unlock from their other ingredients.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/advancement/recipe_unlocks/sulfur_chunk.json}}</ref>

{{History
|{{History line|0.4-alpha|Sulfur was renamed sulfur chunk, with a slightly changed texture.<br />Sulfur chunks work with the new vanilla sulfur blocks.<br />Sulfurous quartz deposits drop both sulfur and quartz.}}
